definitions.full: H2215. zarab [ זָרַב ] verb only Pu`al , meaning dubious; probably (from context) be burnt, scorched — Pu`al Imperfect in relative clause, נִצְמָ֑תוּ יְזָֹֽרְבוּ בְּעֵת Job 6:17 (|| מִמְּקוֺמָם נִדְעֲכוּ בְּחֻמּוֺ ), of brooks scorched and drying up (|| form of צָרַב q. v.; so Ew Di De Hoffm Kau AV RV MV; > Thes Rob-Ges who compare Arabic flow away , compare Late Hebrew זְרִיבָה ; and Mich Dl Pr 36 f. VBm ( are straitened ) RVm ( shrink ) compare Aramaic compress , (Arabic is to make a wooden enclosure ), Assyrian zarâbu , Zim BP 32 n. 56, 70, 95 ).
